title: WOWW: Refactor decryption logic and do not hang on multi-message PDUs
description:
As part of https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/17481 this PR refactors the main decryption logic as well as fixing an issue where encountering a PDU with multiple messages inside of it before having fully deduced the session key would corrupt the remaining server headers.

This was because there is no way of knowing exactly how many headers are in the PDU, and therefore how many times to increment the session key index for the next PDU.

# Captures

The captures are of the Mangos emulator and include movement along with combat and spellcasting. Mangos is an old, tested "production" emulator and should provide a good mix of edge cases. It is probably the most authoritative source on the protocol available, since official Blizzard servers are no longer in use.

commits_data.title: WOWW: Make undecryptable server messages stop decryption
commits_data.message:
WOWW: Make undecryptable server messages stop decryption

Since it is (more or less) impossible to know exactly how many messages
are in a PDU we don't know how many times to increment the session key
index, meaning we might decrypt incorrectly.
To prevent this we freeze the decryption of server messages when we meet
an undecryptable message.
